item.title: The UK's cheapest cities for a Sunday roast named
item.description: Sitting down to a Sunday roast is a great way to round off any UK weekend break, but this can be pricey.The cities offering the most budget-friendly roast have been shared, with a Welsh spot taking the crown. The research was conducted by Sweepstakes Table, who analysed average prices across the UK, with Swansea named the cheapest option. At £12.29 - and offering some incredible walks - this could persuade holidaymakers to pick the city for their next staycation. TRENDING Stories Videos Your Say

item.title: Drivers slam Labour's 20mph rollout as traffic is 'too slow' impacting millions of journeys
item.description: More than two-thirds of drivers have opposed plans to expand 20mph zones across the UK despite Labour pushing for lower speed limits.A new survey found that 66 per cent of motorists are not in favour of cutting key 30mph roads down to 20mph, while 67 per cent believe the limits are "too slow".The findings come as the Government presses ahead with a new Road Safety Strategy aimed at reducing deaths and serious injuries by 65 per cent by 2035.
